features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: At character creation select one of six abilities for a +2 racial increase.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size; do not separately double count size-derived modifiers.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with hume subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: Land speed 30 feet.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Start with Common; additional languages from high Intelligence may be any language allowed by the Linguistics rules.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.description: Select one additional qualifying feat at character level 1.

features.name: Curiosity
features.description: Gain +4 Diplomacy to gather information. Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (local) are class skills; for any of these already provided as a class skill, gain +2 racial to that skill instead.

condition.description: Only when using Diplomacy to gather information

effects.textValue: Class skill unless already class skill; then +2 racial to checks instead.
Class skill unless already class skill; then +2 racial to checks instead.

features.name: Integrated
features.description: Gain +1 racial on Bluff, Disguise and Knowledge (local).

features.name: Skilled
features.description: Gain one additional skill rank at 1st character level and one additional rank at each later character level.

features.name: Sociable
features.description: After failing a Diplomacy attempt to improve attitude by 5 or more, may attempt again before the normal 24-hour wait.

features.name: Adoptive Parentage
features.description: Choose non-hume humanoid ancestry; inherit its starting languages and weapon familiarity. If absent, choose a suitable Skill Focus or Weapon Focus feat instead.

features.name: Alchemically Enhanced
features.description: Choose STR, DEX or CON for +3 racial; take −2 Fortitude against poison.

features.name: Awareness
features.description: +1 racial to every saving throw and concentration check.

features.name: Background Character
features.description: +1 racial to Disguise, Knowledge (dungeoneering), and Stealth checks.

features.name: Comprehensive Education
features.description: Every Knowledge specialization becomes class skill and gains +1 racial bonus on checks.

features.name: Deep Magic
features.description: +2 racial on caster-level checks to overcome spell resistance and on dispel checks.

features.name: Distanced
features.description: +4 racial on Acrobatics checks to pass through threatened squares.

features.name: Dual Talent
features.description: Choose two distinct ability scores, receiving +2 racial to each.

features.name: Emissary
features.description: Once daily, roll twice on one Bluff or Diplomacy check and keep higher result.

features.name: Eye for Talent
features.description: +2 racial Sense Motive. When gaining an animal companion, automaton, avatar, bonded mount, bone commander, cohort, familiar or comparable companion, it gains +2 to a chosen ability.

features.name: Focused Study
features.description: Receive Skill Focus bonus feat at character levels 1, 8, and 16, choosing its skill each time.

features.name: Frontier Survivor
features.description: Gain Technologist as a bonus feat and +2 racial Survival in ruined cities.

features.name: Heart of the Fields
features.description: Choose a Craft or Profession specialization for racial bonus equal to half total character level; once per day ignore one incoming fatigue or exhaustion effect.

features.name: Heart of the Mountains
features.description: +2 racial Climb, and Acrobatics on narrow/uneven surfaces; acclimated to high altitude.

features.name: Heart of the Sea
features.description: +2 racial Profession (sailor) and Swim; both are class skills; breath holding lasts twice normal; casters receive +4 concentration to cast underwater.

features.name: Heart of the Slums
features.description: +2 racial Sleight of Hand and Stealth; +4 racial Survival in urban or underground locations; when saving vs disease roll twice and use better result.

features.name: Heart of the Snows
features.description: Treat cold climate severity one step lower; +2 racial Fortitude against cold climate effects, slipping/falling checks or saves, and CMD vs trip; also Acrobatics/Climb on slick footing.

features.name: Heart of the Streets
features.description: While adjacent to at least two allies, +1 racial Reflex and +1 dodge AC; crowds do not impose difficult terrain.

features.name: Heart of the Sun
features.description: Treat hot climate severity one step lower; +2 racial Fortitude vs hot weather and swarm/vermin poison or distraction.

features.name: Heart of the Wilderness
features.description: Survival racial bonus equals half total character level; +5 racial Constitution checks to stabilize; when computing fatal negative HP threshold treat CON score as higher by half character level.

features.name: Heroic
features.description: If optional hero points apply, gain two hero points each character level instead of one, or three with Blood of Heroes.

features.name: Industrious
features.description: +2 racial concentration and +2 racial to one chosen Craft or Profession specialization.

features.name: Innovative
features.description: +2 racial Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft for original spell research, novel magic-item crafting and unique magic recognition; +2 Charisma-based persuasion promoting new ideas.

features.name: Institutional Memory
features.description: +4 racial Knowledge about the organizations, guilds, religions to which the hume belongs; checks can be untrained.

features.name: Military Tradition
features.description: Proficient with up to two culturally appropriate martial or exotic weapons.

features.name: Mixed Heritage
features.description: Choose a second distinct Heart of the ... alternate racial trait in addition to the normal selected one.

features.name: One of the Multitude
features.description: Within 10 feet of two or more other humanoids gain +1 racial Bluff, Diplomacy, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, Stealth; +1 racial attack of opportunity rolls while flanking.

features.name: Piety
features.description: +2 racial Knowledge (religion), always class skill. Once daily, speak invocation before one attack, save, ability check or skill check to add +2 racial to that roll.

features.name: Practiced Hunter
features.description: +2 racial Stealth and Survival; both become class skills.

features.name: Silver Tongued
features.description: +2 racial Diplomacy and Bluff. Diplomacy attitude improvement can shift up to three stages instead of two.

features.name: Social Ties
features.description: +2 racial Diplomacy, +2 racial skill checks recruiting organization teams or members, +1 racial Leadership score if the feat is possessed.

features.name: Wayfarer
features.description: +2 racial Survival to avoid getting lost, Knowledge (geography) and Knowledge (local). Each Linguistics rank provides two languages instead of one.

features.description: Heritage ability adjustments: {'wis': 2}. Apply instead of the standard racial ability adjustment, never in addition.

features.description: Knowledge (arcana) and Knowledge (planes) both gain +2 racial and become class skills; gain one extra language choice.
